caption: The drawing shows a decorative ceramic plate with a tan or beige background. The central design features a large green and brown stylized leaf or flower with pointy sections radiating from the middle. On either side of the central motif, there are symmetrical floral patterns made up of orange petals, green circles, and brown centers. The wide rim of the plate is adorned with repeating floral and leaf motifs in orange, green, and brown, with small blue accents. The patterns are outlined in dark brown. The entire plate is shown from a top-down perspective against a plain, light-colored background. The signature “E.H. Shakbaz” with the year “1931” is visible near the bottom right side of the plate.
title: Pa. German Dish
